purpose: Fixed synthetic browser checks for the transcript-finalization latency patch. These are test definitions, not measured results.
comparison: Compare STT_FINALIZE_TRANSCRIPTS=false and true in separate server runs. Keep models, TTS instructions/voice, language prompt, microphone and playback device fixed. Restart the server for each mode. Start a fresh browser session and use the cases in order. Do not tune settings within the set.
measurements: Missing, interrupted, repeated or prematurely started responses
STT finalization metadata and user-turn commit time
Server-observed time from speech end to first bot speech

cases.check: One complete transcript and a response after the question ends.
One complete transcript and a response, without waiting for the safety timer when finalization is ready.

cases.utterance: दो और तीन कितने होते हैं?
cases.check: Preserve the Hindi question and do not cut off its final words.

cases.delivery: Pause for approximately 0.8 seconds at the ellipsis; do not say the ellipsis.
cases.check: Keep both parts in order. An incomplete first part must not cause a reply before the ending.

cases.utterance: Tell me about Mumbai ... actually, Bangalore.
cases.delivery: Pause for approximately 0.5 seconds at the ellipsis, then continue.
cases.check: Preserve the correction in the committed text and answer the corrected request, not a reordered or truncated transcript.

cases.utterance: Explain the solar system in two sentences.
cases.interrupt_with: Stop. What is two plus three?
cases.check: Interrupt after the bot starts speaking. Old output should stop, and the new question should receive one response.

reporting: Report plain-question counts and median/range separately from pauses, corrections and interruptions. Include failures and missing responses, not only successful timed responses. Repeat the same frozen set if more samples are needed; do not claim a controlled comparison from different conversations.
